resources.string: Sign in and check usage to get started. Everything below is optional. PC pairing is not required. Start medal and title collection separately with the Growth switches and confirmation. You can return here from Settings at any time.

Reference allocation from your registered payment and observed quota use. This is not an API bill or money saved. Partial observations are a confirmed lower bound.
